verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is a developer framework, not an agent itself, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows client-side MCP support: agents built with the SDK can consume existing or custom MCP servers and OpenAI-hosted MCP tools. That belongs to a different (MCP-client) story, and nothing shows OpenAI publishing an official MCP server for the SDK that external agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
